ledger.x: 1940, 31 March: "The Karelo-Finnish Soviet Socialist Republic was established by the Soviet government on 31 March 1940 by merging the" Karelian ASSR with the Finnish Democratic Republic.

1940, 12 March: the Moscow Peace Treaty cedes the Karelian Isthmus with Viipuri and the Ladoga shore to the Soviet Union; the Karelo-Finnish page puts the ceded lands in the republic ("created in territory ceded by Finland in the Winter War").
1941: Finland "occupied most of the Karelian lands that had been within the USSR before 1940, including the capital Petrozavodsk".
1941: the seat moves to Belomorsk (infobox "Petrozavodsk Belomorsk (1941-1944)").
1944: the seat returns to Petrozavodsk, inferred from the end of the Belomorsk range; the page gives no date.
1944, September: "the Karelian Isthmus with Vyborg (Viipuri) was transferred from the Karelo-Finnish SSR to the Leningrad Oblast"; "Ladoga Karelia remained a part of the republic".
1956, 16 July: "the republic was incorporated into the Russian SFSR as the Karelian Autonomous Soviet Socialist Republic".

certainty.note: The Vyborg circle (90 km) is the researcher's reading of the Isthmus; the page names Vyborg only.
